title: Built a 75 second arcade game in the RUN studio for their jam, here is what the AI got wrong and what worked
author: Friendly_Carry_7728
selftext:
Made this for the RUN september jam, all inside their AI studio. Kiko fixes arcade machines until sunrise, 75 seconds, no game over. Built it over 7 days on the free daily credits.

What worked

\- one change per message with numbers. "cabinet screen rect is x 0.18 to 0.82" gets done, "make the screen look better" burns credits and breaks something else

\- assets outside. Room background and Kiko poses come from ChatGPT and Gemini, then I cut and measure them by hand and give the studio exact pixel positions. It cant guess, it needs numbers

\- screenshot after every good step. Undo goes further back than you think, the screenshot is your save

What the AI got wrong

\- "fixed" is not fixed. Cabinet faces were "fixed" twice and still not visible. Asking for the draw order found it, something was painted over them. Now I ask for the draw list instead of another fix

\- sizes with width/height on sprites break after preload, scale works

\- the studio cannot play the game. Every feel check is you

\- Power mode for a big multi step prompt left the scene broken, back to Quick and one change

Credit wall hit me mid sequence on day 5 so first message next day was "check if half done, undo". Learned that one the hard way.

Not sure the whole thing is the right way to build a game, but for a jam it was fast. Curious what others do for the "fixed but not fixed" problem.

https://w.run/bakko/night-shift
